title: トワイライトシンドローム 探索編
sources: Genkan memory search during play: own 16-bit table, あ = 0x0001 in gojuon order
Three Genkan RAM snapshots of the opening (inbox): lines found with `yomikata locate`, and the layout read off by decoding them against the OCR'd text
notes: Kana mapped (tables/ps1/SLPS-00102.tbl): 16-bit little-endian, a different layout from Moonlight Syndrome. Kanji are 0x0100 up in the scene font's order (聞 0x0122, 雨 0x013E in the opening; 「」 also appear there as 0x0103/0x0104), so they likely change between scenes. 0x8xxx words are control codes (not mapped yet). The small katakana block is the least certain: only ョ was seen.
